objective: Bind the strict external evaluation subject to a canonical public provider/model/runner identity as well as exact source identity.
findings: Exact source identity is insufficient when distinct provider/model/runner configurations can execute the same commit.
A canonical secret-free public runtime/system manifest can be hashed into the strict request subject and revalidated in the claim bridge.
The producer-declared manifest remains unverified until an independent evaluator confirms what runtime actually executed.
claim_boundary: This is internal development evidence. It hardens the external-evaluation subject but cannot satisfy any independent production AGI criterion by itself.
